properties.description: At every eligible observation, fill equals independently modeled occupancy. Pre-edge expected occupancy determines acceptance: full rejects writes, empty rejects reads, and simultaneous requests are accepted independently.
Full is known and asserted exactly when the independent expected queue contains sixteen words.
Empty is known and asserted exactly when the independent expected queue contains zero words.

Whenever the expected queue is nonempty, front data equals its oldest accepted word. Checks ordering and preservation through idle cycles, rejected requests, simultaneous transfers, repeated wraparound, and reset recovery. Empty data is unconstrained.

Public status is known and consistent: fill is between zero and sixteen, full means fill sixteen, and empty means fill zero. This consistency check supplements rather than replaces independent expected-state checks.
After each synchronous reset edge and until the next edge, fill is zero, full is low, and empty is high. Reset also discards the independent scoreboard's prior contents.
